**2 — Vessels:** Beef plate approximately 20 cm across (314 cm²); potato dish approximately 18 cm (254 cm²); vegetable bowl approximately 20 cm (314 cm²).

**3 — Items:** Sliced roast beef; cooked potatoes with herbs and a slight oily sheen; mixed vegetables including peas, corn, green beans, broccoli and cauliflower. Any light potato coating is included in their energy estimate; no separate sauce is clearly visible.
